card.title: Worth Keeping Around
card.instruction: Seek signs that your contribution still earns a place. Increase your effort whenever belonging feels uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep me in the quiz team. I've learned every capital we missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need to justify coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll learn the currencies as a bonus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We like your company. Come early for a drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get there before you and reserve our table. You'll always have a seat if you keep mine.

mechanism: A treats quiz membership as conditional on contribution and converts friendly reassurance into additional service.
confusable: Unlike simple preparation, A must connect the work to keeping their own place.
comparison: S209-b offers table security in exchange for a seat; S209-a offers household reliability to secure lunch belonging.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
